planning_rules: No scientific extraction, root solver, word audit, feature matrix, model fitting, permutation, train/test split or new census was run for this inventory. Only existing metadata/report fields and file hashes were read.
Group by shared construction lineage and transformation identity; both providers, both seeds, interleaved replicas, source copies and the same14rewrites are dependent, not independent samples.
Do not split a helper group across train/test:22 singles, group unions and15V45subsets overlap. Counterfactual price rows share one source and one objective.
Local positive pricing may be cancelled by freed-width idle costs, added buffers, physical delivery and outer obligations. Missing charges/labels remain missing, never zero.
Profiles, exact objective deltas, accepted flag, publishedκ, stage index and source/PR identity leak a target if used as predictor. Feature definitions and ablations must be preregistered separately.
The selected1094T16 construction, modernT74/T370 denominator, supplier-only versus full outer κ, and integer search surrogate use different conventions; normalize explicitly before comparisons.
Original r11 M1/M2 stopped protocols and all continuation stops remain binding to those exact domains. Historical data analysis does not authorize rerunning them.

Complete raw failed candidate words exist for some families, but receipt collections are the authoritative eligibility/price/guard labels. Verify any loaded artifact against its saved reference before later feature extraction.

R2 records priced_candidates96 perseed are attempted pricing, not96moments:all failL-not-inside-U and zero moments complete. Keep all96EXPLORATORY under immutable receipts; separate post-run parity proof is a diagnostic.
